findings.text: §8's "not running" rule has the retention command call `squeue` directly (as implemented at `imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_retention.py:112`) instead of extending a query owner, so a fifth spelling of the account-liveness read joins the four already in `cli.py:1087`, `:1244`, `:1983`, `:2306`; `slurm.py` owns submission but publishes no query, which is the file to extend

findings.reason: the section explicitly states the consolidation belongs to another node, so the deferral is accounted for and a naming sentence would not move the design.
findings.text: §9 adds a new public reader function in `imas_ambix/agent/watch.py` and a published `third-party-cache-rate.json` record while the week's budget is cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, public_definitions 0, refusal_families 0, and the section names nothing it retires or merges in this repository — it defers the only consolidation (gpu-watch's copy) to a separate followup

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §11's `imas_ambix/agent/live_panel.py` (526 lines) and §12's `provider_prices.py` each hide their whole concern (lane copy, receipt differencing, run-boundary logic; fetch, atomic write, path resolution) behind a handful of functions rather than spreading wrappers over the same machinery.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §8's retention liveness rule ("the job id appears in no squeue state") is a scheduler query with no owner to extend; `squeue` is already invoked independently at `imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:1087`, `:1244`, `:1983` and `:2306`, and `imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py` owns every other SLURM interaction but exposes no query.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — the one section that adds CLI surface (§11, `--live`) and the one that adds a module (§12) each name what they retire or why nothing can merge: §11 states `--live` cannot merge into `--json` and that the readers it replaces live in the dotfiles repository, and §12 retires `DEFAULT_PRICE_PATH`.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the mechanism it extends at each proposal: the existing index key `(host, boot_id, inode, offset)` (§2), `counter_span` and `_prefix_hit_rate` (§3), one shared run predicate between compactor and query (§8), `ledger_cost`/`match_price`/`price_at` (§9), `counter_run_continues` and `lane.availability_percent` (§11), and `SiteConfig` for the price path (§12).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no section adds an unjustified forwarding layer: §10 is a net deletion of gpu-watch's private ledger and price code, and §12 states the migration path (`SiteConfig`) rather than adding a parallel owner.
